direction: Anime background architecture, adult scale, restrained PBR daylight; original geometry following the project's SAO first-floor reference policy.
source_axis: Blender meters, +Z up, +Y facade; UE import=(x,-y,z)*100; native facade -Y
uv_rule: UV0 uses metric face projection; every repeated tile uses the same UV rectangle. No unique atlas cell per tile. Lightmap UV is separate when needed.
scope: Static environment kit and first usable street; the current reused character rig remains a provisional visual pending a dedicated anime character pass. No VR performance claim.
